problem.title: Hiring in Cameroon has always been informal. joballa changes that.

workers.title: For workers
workers.description: Build one verified profile that works as your CV across every application. No more printing documents or sending files over WhatsApp.

employers.title: For employers
employers.description: Post jobs, review structured candidate profiles, hire, manage shifts, and pay workers — all in one place. No chasing, no guesswork.

informal.title: For informal work
informal.description: Domestic, education, events, logistics — joballa's managed departments give informal workers a verified channel and clients a trusted way to hire.

oneProfile.title: One profile. Every opportunity.
oneProfile.description: Your joballa profile replaces the CV. Build it once, apply everywhere. Employers see a standardised, verified view of every candidate — no formatting games, no inconsistencies.

preview.summary: AWS-certified architect designing resilient cloud platforms for African enterprises. Experienced in migrations, Kubernetes, and cost-optimised infrastructure.

work.description: Led migration of legacy workloads to AWS and built multi-region Kubernetes platforms for enterprise clients across Central Africa.

identity.title: Verified identity

skills.title: Skills & work history

cv.title: Download as a CV

payments.title: Get paid directly to your phone.
payments.description: No bank account needed. Workers receive payments directly to their MTN MoMo or Orange Money account. Employers initiate transfers from their dashboard — every transaction is recorded and confirmed.

mobile.title: Mobile money payments
mobile.description: Employers pay workers via MTN MoMo or Orange Money — directly from their joballa payroll dashboard. Workers receive an SMS confirmation instantly.

records.title: Full payment records
records.description: Every payment is logged. Workers can track earnings and export statements. Employers keep a full payroll history — clean records for both sides.

seekers.title: Find opportunities that match your skills
seekers.description: Browse curated roles, save searches, and apply with a verified joballa profile instead of sending another one-off CV.

employers.title: Hire talent that drives your business
employers.description: Publish roles with guardrails, evaluate applicants consistently, and keep workforce and payout context in sync.
